components.name: Primary button
components.description: Implemented primary action with shared focus and disabled treatment.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:41px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:6px;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;color:#fff;background:var(--blue,#2559ce);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-hover,#1944a5);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#5686f0);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Native filing field with persistent label and shared focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif}.ds-field label{display:block;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--ink,#1e293b)}.ds-field input{width:100%;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccd6e4;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 11px;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--ink,#1e293b);caret-color:var(--blue,#2559ce)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#66758a}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#5686f0);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Assistant workflow row
components.description: Divided full-width action used inside the desk assistant.
components.css: .ds-workflow{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;gap:12px;padding:16px 0;background:transparent;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e1e7ef);text-align:left;color:#253c5c;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-workflow svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.65;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;color:#4a6c9e}.ds-workflow span{flex:1;font-weight:600;font-size:.875rem}.ds-workflow small{display:block;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted,#58677c);margin-top:5px}.ds-workflow:hover span{color:var(--blue,#2559ce)}.ds-workflow .ds-chevron{width:14px;color:#6b7b91}.ds-workflow:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#5686f0);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-source{margin:17px 0 22px;font-family:"Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif}.ds-source summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;color:#445b7a}.ds-source summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#5686f0);outline-offset:3px}.ds-source p{margin-top:12px;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.75;color:#3f5066;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-source summary{padding:5px 0}}

narrative.overview:
This is a record of the implemented officer interface, preserving the repository's BlotterSync identity. Slate navigation frames a light working canvas; blue identifies actions, while compact type and clear borders support scanning incident records and reviewing source text. The descriptor names the existing surface rather than proposing a new visual world.

The source of truth for this extraction is `BlotterSync/wwwroot/workspace.css`, with component structure and behavior in `workspace.html` and `workspace.js`. This record covers that extension; it does not claim that every legacy route has been migrated to these measurements. The Segoe UI/system stack is inherited product identity.
keyCharacteristics: Slate navigation, blue actions, white bordered working surfaces.
Compact sentence-case labels, native fields and readable incident narratives.
Flat persistent panels, with shadows reserved for transient overlays.
Explicit text labels distinguish incident status, draft review and assistance mode.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Preserve the visible state name alongside its semantic color.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces for persistent working panels; reserve the implemented shadows for transient overlays.

dos: **Do** retain the BlotterSync name, inherited Segoe UI/system stack, slate navigation and blue actions.
**Do** keep status names, assistance mode and source comparisons visible in review flows.
**Do** reuse bordered working panels, native labeled fields and shared keyboard focus treatment.
**Do** preserve line breaks and wrapping for incident and source narratives.
donts: **Don't** treat a draft acceptance state as an incident filing state.
**Don't** add resting shadows to the flat working panels described by this extraction.
**Don't** treat generated sidecar tonal ramps as implemented color tokens.
**Don't** assume this workspace extraction replaces the styling of untouched legacy routes.
